errors.description: The drawn pocket mouth is an OPEN path; the render closed it into a quadrilateral panel.
errors.expected: An open pocket mouth: a short vertical drop from the waistband, a sharp corner, then a single straight slanted run terminating at the front crease. Three connected edges, open at both ends.
errors.actual: A fully enclosed four-sided trapezoid outlined on the face of the cloth, with a closing right-hand edge that does not exist in the illustration.
errors.correction: Render the pocket as an OPENING, not an outlined shape. The stitch line must terminate at the front crease and at the waistband — it must not close back on itself.

errors.description: Rendered as a stitched-on patch/panel rather than a pocket opening with a mouth.
errors.expected: A jeans-style front pocket opening: a visible mouth with a topstitched edge, the pocket bag concealed behind the cloth.
errors.actual: A flat outlined trapezoid with no readable opening; no mouth, no depth, no bag entry. The pocket bag appears drawn onto the outside of the trouser front.
errors.correction: Show a genuine opening with a slight natural gape and a pressed, topstitched mouth edge. The pocket bag must never be outlined on the face of the cloth.

errors.description: The defining 90 degree corner transition is not readable.
errors.expected: A sharp, unmistakable 90 degree corner where the vertical drop from the waistband turns into the slanted run — this right angle is the entire discriminator versus the Arc Jeans Pocket sibling.
errors.actual: The corner is absorbed into a trapezoid whose edges meet at soft, ambiguous angles; no crisp right angle reads at one second.
errors.correction: Force the right angle: state that the vertical segment drops about 4 cm from the waistband seam and then turns through a hard 90 degree corner with a bar tack at the corner, and that a curved or chamfered corner is a failure.
